segments.text: This is an iPhone 17 Pro Max and this is
a Xiaomi 17 Pro Max. And as a product
strategy, this is kind of hilarious. But
guess what? Xiaomi has been not so
subtly appealing to iPhone users for a
while now. This year, it's just more
straightforward than ever. They
literally changed the name of their
phones to match the iPhone. So, it's
it's obvious, but hey, this phone is
like the iPhone, but better. Like the
screen is like an iPhone, but it's
better because it gets so much brighter
and has a smaller notch and has an
ultrasonic fingerprint reader. The
design is very much like an iPhone, but
the screen on the back, well, that's
better. That you can use as a viewfinder
to take actually highquality selfies or
display notifications or even play whole
games with this retro case. The Pro
iPhones have triple 48 megapixel cameras
this year, so naturally the Xiaomi has
triple 50 megapixel cameras. And the Pro
Max here has a 7,500
mAh silicon carbon battery. So that's
like 50% more battery than the iPhone.
And it charges faster. So somewhere out
there there was a customer who was about
to buy an iPhone, but then they see this
and it's cheaper and they may be
convinced.
